author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if hype wasn’t just for halftime? In this talk, Jake Fehling challenges us to rethink the role of hype in the workforce, in the home, and in your own everyday life. As the official in-stadium hype man of the Carolina Panthers, Jake shows us how we can shift our own perspective to change any environment for the better. By utilizing hype in your life, you help your people excel. 

Jake is the Chief Marketing Officer for Movement Mortgage, one of the fastest growing private mortgage lenders in the country. On Sundays in Charlotte, you can find him pumping up Carolina Panthers fans as the team's in-stadium "Hype Man." Prior to his career in the financial services industry, Jake spent four years in executive search in the life sciences, leading senior-level searches in the medical device, biotech and digital health sectors. Jake's early career was rooted in sports business, where he led international media and marketing operations for the U.S. Olympic Committee, USA Baseball and the I
title: A hype man's advice on supporting others | Jake Fehling | TEDxUnity Park

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world obsessed with careers and titles, this talk challenges a deeper question: who are you becoming? Through powerful stories and a simple three-pillar framework—Identity, Purpose, and Contribution—it reveals how true success begins within. It inspires individuals to discover their inner “jewel” and take responsibility for their own transformation. Because the most important thing you will ever build… is yourself. Vishesh Gupta is the Vice General Director of Soka Gakkai International and Chairperson of Bharat Soka Gakkai (BSG), a nationwide movement promoting peace, sustainability, and human dignity. With over three decades of association, he has led transformative initiatives like *BSG for SDGs* and large-scale environmental campaigns, expanding the organization’s impact across India. 

A strong advocate of youth leadership, sustainability, and global citizenship, he has represented these ideas at major national and international forums. Prior to his work with BSG, he had a di
title: Have the courage to create yourself | Vishesh Gupta | TEDxJaipur National University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In his TEDx talk, “The Best Medicine Starts Outside the Clinic Window,” Bertrand Dushimumuremyi challenges conventional healthcare by emphasizing the deep connection between human health, nature, and environment. He advocates a One Health approach, urging prevention through ecological awareness, community action, and looking beyond hospital walls. Bertrand is an MD candidate at the University of Global Health Equity (UGHE), aspiring
to end the burden of preventable deaths in the pediatric and adult population on the continent and globally. His top interests lie in Pediatric Health, Global Health advocacy, One Health championing, and advancing Precision and Molecular medicine research.
As a healthcare professional, he understands the interconnectedness of the human and ecosystem world is a substantial and undeniable fact. His recent work is centered on advocacy for One Health centered systems. His past work as the Chair of the Student One Health Innovation Club at UGHE has set foundati
title: The best medicine starts outside the clinic window | Bertrand Dushimumuremyi | TEDxKigali

author: TEDx Talks
description: Don't ask for permission; earn the right not to do so. In this bold and unapologetic TEDx Talk, Meryl Poster explains her dichotomous method for making a name for yourself in high-profile arenas. Informed by her own journey of ascendancy in Hollywood, Poster explains why success in prominent environments necessitates a balance between Apollonian reason and order and Dionysian passion and impulse. Meryl Poster is a multi-award-winning producer, media executive, and industry leader with a distinguished career spanning film, television, and digital media. Known for her collaborative management style and strong talent relationships, Poster played a pivotal role in shaping some of the most critically acclaimed films of the late 1990s and 2000s. During her tenure as co-president of production at Miramax, Poster oversaw the development and production of many Academy Award-winning and nominated films, including Chicago, Cider House Rules, Good Will Hunting, The Talented Mr. Ripley, Shakespear
title: How to Think Like Apollo and Live Like Dionysus | Meryl Poster | TEDxWakeForestU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
The session explored how AI enhances what humans bring to the table, but cannot replace the fundamentals of success: love for what we do, consistency, and discipline. It highlighted that in an AI-driven world, these human qualities become even more essential for meaningful growth and leadership. An emerging entrepreneur exploring the intersection of philosophy and enterprise, representing a new generation building with AI as a primary collaborator. With a background in Communication and Advertising, he is currently pursuing a Master’s in Innovation & Entrepreneurship at ESEI Business School.

Gus Reed is an emerging entrepreneur exploring the intersection between philosophy, entrepreneurship, and artificial intelligence. Part of the first generation building alongside AI as a creative collaborator, he combines philosophical thinking with venture creation. He holds a background in Philosophy and is currently pursuing a Master’s in Innovation & Entrepreneurship at ESEI Business School.
title: Meaning First | Alex Macolino & Gus Reed | TEDxEsei School Barcelona

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if learning didn’t end in classrooms but transformed lives in communities? In this inspiring TEDx talk, Jules Ndashimye explores how voluntourism and ecotourism can bridge academia with real-world impact—empowering students, uplifting local communities, and redefining education as a tool for sustainable, inclusive change. Jules NDASHIMYE, based in Rubavu, Rwanda, is a respected academic and professional in tourism management. He holds a Master’s Degree in Tourism Management. He has over 12 years of experience teaching at universities, where he has contributed to curriculum development, student mentorship, and departmental leadership.
His academic and professional expertise spans tourism industry development, MSME business support with a focus on community-based tourism enterprises (CBTEs), and the design of innovative tourism products and experiences. Jules has also been actively engaged in conservation initiatives and tourism project management, reflecting his commitment to sust
title: Bridging Academia with Communities through Voluntourism & Ecotourism | Jules NDASHIMYE | TEDxKigali

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this TEDx talk, he argues that the willingness to be laughed at — to be publicly and visibly incompetent, and to keep going anyway — may be one of the most practical superpowers available to anyone. Drawing from experiences across the Army, competitive sport, entrepreneurship, and life after uniform, he explores why protecting your image is one of the most expensive habits most people carry — and what becomes possible when you let it go. Devashish Chakravarty is Founder of Quetzal Verify and SalaryNext, an ex-Major from the Indian Army, IIM Ahmedabad gold medallist, columnist on careers for The Economic Times, mentor, and author of Get Hired in 30 Days. From ranking first in the UPSC-NDA entrance and scoring 100 percentile in CAT to building ventures, writing, mentoring, and competing across multiple sports, his journey reflects excellence across domains. A multi-sport and adventure sports achiever, he has represented the country and state and competed across sailing, shooting, bri
title: The Willingness to Be Laughed At | Devashish Chakravarty | TEDxJaipur National University

description:
Learn about how living in discomfort once in a while can be beneficial to your daily life. Marion CAMPAN, PCC.
Managing Director at INTANDID
 
Marion Campan is a corporate culture and leadership expert. Her experience lies in helping organizations create thriving workplaces.
 
She specializes in employee engagement, leadership development, and building high-performing teams through a strengths-based approach. Marion has a deep understanding of international business environments, having spent more than two decades abroad and helping teams adapt to change and future-of-work challenges.
 
A certified ICF PCC and Gallup Strengths Coach, Marion empowers leaders to align purpose, values, and culture to drive both people and business results. She is a sought-after speaker, including a TEDx talk on finding the ideal workplace, and leads bespoke training programs and exclusive HR communities designed to foster growth, collaboration, and meaningful impact. title: The Power of Discomfort | Marion Campan | TEDxSMICSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Reprendre une vie pleine de sens consiste à sortir de la suractivité inutile en faisant des choix plus conscients. Cela implique de trier ses engagements, de clarifier ses priorités et d’accepter des moments de vide pour mieux se recentrer sur l’essentiel. Diplômée de la faculté de médecine de l'Université Teikyo en 2005, elle forge son expertise dans les plus grands hôpitaux de Tokyo - Nippon Medical School, Tokyo Women's Medical University, Machida Municipal Hospital. En 2012, elle obtient sa certification officielle en dermatologie. Mais Yuki Tamaki ne s'arrête jamais là où les autres s'installent.

En 2014, elle ouvre sa première clinique. Puis une deuxième en 2019. Une troisième en 2020. Trois établissements. Des milliers de patients. Une mission : rendre la santé de la peau accessible à tous, des enfants aux familles entière… This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/ted
title: Reclaim your life by letting go of unnecessary busyness | YUKI TAMAKI | TEDxMoursal

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this compelling and deeply personal talk, entrepreneur and educator Anil Somani shares his extraordinary journey from a struggling student to a successful industry leader. When his family's business collapsed, leaving them entirely in debt with a total cash balance of just ₹12, Somani had to rely on a profound sense of resilience and the power of alternatives to rebuild his life from scratch.

Whether you are an aspiring entrepreneur, a student navigating your path, or someone facing an insurmountable setback, Somani’s testament to the "upward trajectory" will inspire you to keep pushing forward. Anil Somani is a prominent Indian educationist and entrepreneur, best known as the Founder and Executive Chairman of the FOSTIIMA Business School in New Delhi. He is distinguished for his "IIT-IIM" academic pedigree and his transition from a successful corporate and pharmaceutical career into the education sector This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but indep
title: The Power of Alternatives: Navigating Life's Upward Trajectory | Anil Somani | TEDxBRAC

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when a nation slowly begins to lose the language it thinks in, speaks in, and dreams in?
This talk explores how globalization, digital culture, and younger generations’ language habits are reshaping Mongolian language and identity. It is a reminder that language is not just communication—it is memory, culture, and the core of who we are becoming. Meet our pilot, Bilguun, a Class of 2028A student who sees possibilities in every direction. Brilliant, flexible, and boldly different, he navigates ideas beyond the ordinary and turns unexpected perspectives into new flight paths. 

Through his topic, “Монгол хэл, соёлын алдагдал,” Bilguun explores the importance of preserving language and culture, and why protecting our identity today is essential for shaping tomorrow. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Монгол хэл, соёлын алдагдал  | Bilguun Ganzorig | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

description:
What an unoriginal desire to be original?
What if everyone’s obsession with standing out is exactly what is making us all look the same?
This talk explores how the pressure to be “unique” can actually pull us away from our true selves, and how we often forget that we were already born different before trying to become different. It’s a reminder that real originality doesn’t come from copying individuality—it comes from simply being yourself without filters. Meet our pilot, Nandin-Erdene, a Class of 2027C student whose ambition and entrepreneurial spirit fuel this journey forward. Creative, expressive, and unapologetically bold, she brings ideas that are as powerful as they are distinctive. Beyond the stage, Nandin-Erdene has also contributed as a marketing volunteer, helping shape the vision behind this journey.

Fasten your seatbelts — this flight is driven by vision. Through her thought-provoking topic, “What an Unoriginal Desire to Be Original?”, Nandin-Erdene challenges us to reth
title: What an unoriginal desire to be original?  | Nandin-Erdene Battulga | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the reason we misunderstand each other isn’t because we disagree—but because we literally think in different mental languages?
This talk explores how perception, inner experience, and cognition vary from person to person, from how we see colors to how we form thoughts in words, images, or concepts. It is a reminder that communication is not just about speaking clearly, but about learning how to translate our minds into someone else’s way of understanding. Meet our speaker, Munkhtulga, a Class of 2027A student who sees beyond the obvious, takes responsibility with intention, stays optimistic through every turn, and navigates every idea with clarity and logic. 

Through his topic, “The 24/7 Narrator,” Munkhtulga explores the constant voice within us — how our inner dialogue shapes our thoughts, influences our decisions, and ultimately defines the stories we tell ourselves every day. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized b
title: The 24/7 NARRATOR | Munkhtulga Battulga | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the biggest pressure we feel today is not from life itself—but from trying to “catch up” to it?
This talk explores how rising anxiety and stress in young people may be linked not only to technology, but to constant comparison, speed, and the feeling that life is always ahead of us. It is a reminder that slowing down, being present, and finishing today without borrowing worry from tomorrow might be one of the most important skills for mental well-being. Meet our pilot, Ariungua, a Class of 2027B student whose curiosity and bold thinking guide this journey beyond expectations. With an unpredictable spirit and boundless imagination, she challenges the way we see time, choices, and the future.

 Through her thought-provoking topic, “Өнөөдөртөө маргаашаа дуусгах уу?”, Ariungua invites us to reflect on whether we are truly living in the present — or quietly finishing tomorrow before it even begins. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently
title: Өнөөдөртөө маргаашаа дуусгах уу?  | Ariungua Enkhsaikhan | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In Multi-Disciplinary Mental Models, Mr. Sankarsh Chanda explores how mental models — simple frameworks for understanding how things work — empower better thinking and decision-making across disciplines. Drawing inspiration from legendary investor Charlie Munger, he explains that life’s complex problems are better approached not with one narrow mindset, but with a latticework of interconnected thinking tools.
Sankarsh demystifies mental models by showing how they apply to everyday activities like communication, problem-solving, writing, and teamwork — including his own experience bridging gaps between technical, coding, and aerospace science teams. He emphasises that mental models aren’t 100% correct, but being approximately right is far superior to being exactly wrong when navigating uncertainty.
He highlights the power of questioning — asking “why” to deepen understanding, and using decision-making frameworks that consider worst-case outcomes to avoid irreversible mistakes. He advoc
title: Multi-Disciplinary Mental Models | Sankarsh Chanda | TEDxYouth@LPHS

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In Soundtracking a Generation, Shaan reflects on how music becomes the emotional backdrop of our lives — shaping memories, relationships, and identity. He challenges the common belief that growth must come only from hardship, sharing that life itself — whether smooth or stormy — is always an opportunity to evolve and contribute.
Through personal insights and life lessons from his journey in the music industry, he speaks about staying calm and composed amidst daily challenges. He emphasizes the importance of responding thoughtfully rather than reacting impulsively, especially in situations beyond our control.
Shaan also highlights the power of having faith in your dreams — trusting your Plan A while being wise enough to prepare for Plan B. With resilience, patience, and focus, he reminds us that success is built not just on talent, but on discipline and perspective.
Ultimately, his message is simple yet powerful: life will constantly present lessons — the key is to remain open, learn f
title: Soundtracking a Generation | Shantanu Mukherjee | TEDxYouth@LPHS

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if your greatest strength has been with you all along—hidden in your history, your environment, and your daily struggles?

This talk explores how Mongolian heritage, shaped by extreme climates and nomadic survival, has built generations of resilience, discipline, and adaptability. It is a reminder that the ability to endure, grow, and succeed may already be written into who we are. Meet one of our pilots, Jonon, a Class of 2027B student guiding our journey with responsibility, enthusiasm, and versatility. With a steady sense of direction and a courageous mindset, he ensures this flight never loses its course.

Through his topic, “Live Bravely with No Regrets,” Jonon encourages us to embrace challenges, take bold steps, and live each moment with purpose and confidence. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Live Bravely with No Regrets | Jonon Erdenetsogt | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

description:
What if the biggest thing holding you back in exams isn’t your ability—but your mindset?
This talk explores how stress, fear, and “laziness” are often rooted in our thoughts and emotions, and how shifting your inner dialogue can change your performance completely. It’s a reminder that by managing your mindset, moving your body, and taking action, you can turn anxiety into confidence and potential into results. Meet our pilot, Chimegnasan, a Class of 2027B student whose curiosity, determination, and relentless drive push this flight beyond comfortable altitudes. Unafraid to question the route, this speaker brings ideas that challenge perspectives and spark new ways of thinking. Through the topic “АйДас”, Chimegnasan explores the fears we carry, the limits we create, and how confronting them can open new paths forward. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: АйДас | Chimegnasan Sosorburam | TEDxOrkhon KhaSu IS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: What takes YOU “home”? By embracing our roots and honoring our cultural memories, we can carry a piece of home with us everywhere. Drawing upon the power of culture and connection from my 30 years of creating the vibrant LEAF Festival at my home, Lake Eden, this festival became my canvas for building community and nurturing belonging for many. Artists, especially those displaced from their home countries, taught me that it’s the shared stories, music, and traditions that connect us across borders. Jennifer Pickering is a visionary cultural leader, creative placemaker, consultant and global connector who believes we can all “Live Life Like a Festival”—the title of her upcoming book launching this fall at Lake Eden Retreat. As founder of LEAF Global Arts, originally Lake Eden Arts Festival (1995), she transformed her childhood home for 30 years into a gathering place where music, culture, and community connect. Under her leadership, LEAF welcomed 40,000 artists from 117 nations, inspiri
title: Finding Your Way Home Through Culture | Jennifer Jane Pickering | TEDxAsheville

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if your deepest anxieties and darkest emotions hold the key to your greatest strength? Artist and speaker Kathleen Brophy shares the compelling story of how her passion for drawing became a powerful tool for self-discovery and mental healing. By delving into dark and vulnerable self-expression, she realized that the ability to honestly admit and depict turmoil is a profound form of grit. The talk uses powerful examples of this art—most notably an impactful piece featuring a snake-human hybrid—to illustrate how creating something scary and vulnerable can make you stronger and more resilient. The core message is clear: strength is found in your willingness to be tender and real. Kathleen, a graduating Grade 12 student, has spent four years at Brentwood, balancing academic focus with a deep commitment to the arts. Art has been a lifelong passion and a crucial mechanism for mental wellness and navigating personal struggles. Her diverse background includes six family moves across the
title: An artist's lesson in strength | Kathleen Brophy | TEDxBrentwoodCollegeSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In her talk, Afghan Olympian Friba Rezayee reflects on how she used grit to defy the ban on women's judo, making history in the 2004 Athens Olympic Games. This participation was a "sport revolution" that challenged gender stereotypes and paved the way for hundreds of Afghan women to play sports.  Friba Rezayee is Afghanistan’s first female Olympic athlete. She represented Afghanistan at the2004 Athens Olympic Games in the  sport of Judo. She has inspired hundreds of women and girls to join sports. It was a sports revolution, and a women's rights movement in Afghanistan. Friba was recently invited to sign the Olympians’ wall at the Olympic House in Switzerland.

She is now the founder and the Executive Director of Women Leaders of Tomorrow in Canada. A nonprofit dedicated to Afghan women’s education, leadership and empowerment. WLOT has been leveraging millions of dollars in scholarships, and raising hundreds of thousands of dollars to support Afghan women and girls’ education in Canad
title: Think Possibility | Friba Rezayee | TEDxBrentwoodCollegeSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description:
As AI reshapes how we work and interact, human connection becomes more essential than ever. This talk explores why belonging, trust, and meaningful relationships are the real infrastructure that allow technology to serve people rather than replace them.

Through insights from leadership, education, and collaboration, it highlights how we can intentionally create environments where people feel connected, valued, and empowered in the age of AI. Yohay Elam is a second-time entrepreneur and the founder of TouchBase, an app that helps people reconnect and strengthen relations with those they care about. It's part of the bigger problem of loneliness. 
He previously launched a content website catering to retail forex traders, a business that was acquired, and has experience in product management and software development. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Human connection as infrastructure | Yohay Elam | TEDxEsei School Barcelona
